sentences.sentence_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to industrialize governed agentic AI, linking control-plane architecture, a productized delivery model, and alliance distribution into reusable IP that enabled regulated-enterprise adoption and turned bespoke expertise into scalable platform services.
